items.headline: 2026 Major Season Recap
items.text: The 2026 major championship season featured winners like Rory McIlroy, Scottie Scheffler, and Bryson DeChambeau, highlighting notable winners and losers.

items.headline: LPGA Launches Nanea Cup
items.text: The LPGA announced the inaugural $4 million Nanea Cup March 11-14 in Hawaii, mixing 95 LPGA pros with 25 top collegiate players, spotlighting future and current stars.

items.headline: McIlroy Backs New Tour Partnership
items.text: Rory McIlroy supported the multi-year PGA Tour–DP World Tour–Asian Tour alliance through 2029, praising its pathways for Asian players and a blow to LIV Golf affiliations.
